text: Supreme Court skeptical of Apple's monopoly on app purchases through its App Store Monday, 26 November 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) Apple's pricing policies for iPhone apps bought on its exclusive App Store ran into trouble Monday at the Supreme Court.
